subject: astronomy
title: Planets & Moons: The Outer Giants
welcome_lead: Huge, swirling and ringed — meet the gas and ice giants.
meta_desc: KS3 astronomy: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune and their moons.
final_note: Giant planets host whole families of moons.

walkthroughs.body_html: Jupiter has a huge storm called the Great Red Spot. Saturn's rings are made of billions of ice chunks. Both are gas giants.
Uranus spins almost on its side. Neptune has the fastest winds in the solar system — over 2000 km/h.
Europa (Jupiter) and Enceladus (Saturn) likely have liquid water under thick ice. Titan has lakes of liquid methane.
